cli_help:
Synapsor Runner

Safe MCP tools for Postgres/MySQL-backed agent actions.

Usage:
  synapsor-runner <command>

Commands:
  try          Prove the boundary or drive active project tools and exploration
  inspect      Inspect a Postgres/MySQL schema
  start        Start guided own-database setup, or no-arg legacy worker polling
  action       Validate/watch disabled TypeScript Safe Action drafts
  up           Bring up local review mode guidance/server
  init         Generate a Synapsor capability contract
  config       Validate local synapsor.runner.json wiring
  mcp          Serve safe semantic tools over MCP
  contract     Validate and normalize canonical Synapsor contract files
  effect       Catch changed agent business effects with offline fixtures
  report       Export and verify scoped tamper-evident ledger reports
  policy       Evaluate and review opt-in graduated-trust recommendations
  dsl          Compile SQL-like Synapsor authoring DSL to contract JSON
  language-server  Start the Synapsor contract LSP over stdio
  cloud        Register runner metadata or dry-run contract push to Cloud
  onboard      One-command own-database setup
  smoke        Test generated tool calls before wiring an MCP client
  tools        List model-facing MCP tools and aliases
  writeback    Print direct SQL writeback receipt DDL, grants, and checks
  handler      Create app-owned writeback handler templates
  propose      Create a local evidence-backed proposal
  audit        Review MCP/database tool risk
  proposals   Review, approve, or reject proposals
  lifecycle   Inspect an action from proposal through receipt/replay
  evidence    Inspect local evidence bundles
  query-audit Inspect local query audit records
  receipts    Inspect guarded writeback receipts
  activity    Search local evidence/replay ledger
  events      Tail or push local proposal/writeback lifecycle events
  metrics     Export tenant/capability operational counters
  activation  Inspect/export the local try-to-first-proposal funnel
  attention   Inspect human-attention work without copying proposal IDs
  notifications  Test and dispatch quiet, signed operator notifications
  worker      Run or inspect the supervised local writeback queue
  store       Inspect and maintain the local SQLite ledger
  shadow      Compare shadow proposals with authoritative outcomes
  apply        Apply an approved proposal with guarded writeback
  revert       Create a reviewed compensation proposal for an applied write
  replay       Show what happened
  demo         Start the local commit-safety demo
  ui           Open the local review UI

Examples:
  synapsor-runner try
  synapsor-runner try --prove --yes --no-open
  synapsor-runner start --from-env DATABASE_URL
  synapsor-runner start --action refund_order --description "Propose one reviewed order refund"
  synapsor-runner action validate ./synapsor/actions/billing.propose_refund_order.ts
  synapsor-runner up --config ./synapsor.runner.json --store ./.synapsor/local.db --dry-run
  synapsor-runner onboard db --from-env DATABASE_URL
  synapsor-runner inspect --from-env DATABASE_URL
  synapsor-runner init --wizard --from-env DATABASE_URL
  synapsor-runner config validate --config ./synapsor.runner.json
  synapsor-runner contract validate ./synapsor.contract.json
  synapsor-runner contract normalize ./synapsor.contract.json --out ./synapsor.contract.normalized.json
  synapsor-runner contract explain ./contract.synapsor.sql --format markdown
  synapsor-runner contract lint ./contract.synapsor.sql --strict
  synapsor-runner lifecycle --store ./.synapsor/local.db
  synapsor-runner lifecycle show --object invoice:INV-3001 --details --store ./.synapsor/local.db
  synapsor-runner effect fixture create --from-replay replay_wrp_... --request "Waive the late fee" --contract ./synapsor.contract.json --store ./.synapsor/local.db --out ./effects/late-fee.json
  synapsor-runner effect run --fixture ./effects/late-fee.json --result ./effects/late-fee.result.json
  synapsor-runner report --object invoice:INV-3001 --tenant tenant_acme --store ./.synapsor/local.db --format markdown
  synapsor-runner policy recommend --contract ./synapsor.contract.json --config ./synapsor.runner.json --tenant tenant_acme --capability billing.propose_credit --policy low_risk_credit --store ./.synapsor/local.db
  synapsor-runner dsl compile ./contract.synapsor.sql --out ./synapsor.contract.json
  synapsor-runner language-server --stdio
  synapsor-runner cloud push ./synapsor.contract.json --dry-run
  synapsor-runner smoke call --config ./synapsor.runner.json --store ./.synapsor/local.db
  synapsor-runner tools list --aliases --config ./synapsor.runner.json --store ./.synapsor/local.db
  synapsor-runner handler template node-fastify --output ./synapsor-writeback-handler.mjs
  synapsor-runner mcp serve --config ./synapsor.runner.json --store ./.synapsor/local.db
  synapsor-runner propose billing.propose_late_fee_waiver --sample
  synapsor-runner audit ./synapsor.runner.json
  synapsor-runner activation show --config ./synapsor.runner.json --store ./.synapsor/local.db

Global options:
  --secrets-provider aws-secretsmanager-cli --secret-map-env SYNAPSOR_SECRET_MAP
  --secrets-provider env-json --secret-map-env SYNAPSOR_SECRET_MAP --secret-values-env SYNAPSOR_SECRET_VALUES

tool_catalog.name: support.inspect_customer
tool_catalog.title: support.inspect_customer
tool_catalog.description:
Inspect one support customer in the trusted tenant before proposing a plan credit.
Returns reviewed customer fields plus evidence/query-audit handles.
Evidence handles are audit/replay handles; the model does not need to call them during this turn.

tool_catalog.name: support.propose_plan_credit
tool_catalog.title: support.propose_plan_credit
tool_catalog.description:
Propose a bounded support plan credit after inspecting customer and ticket evidence.
Returns a proposal id, exact diff, evidence handle, and source_database_changed:false. Policy may approve small credits, but writeback is still separate.
Evidence handles are audit/replay handles; the model does not need to call them during this turn.

reason.description: Business reason tied to support evidence.

tool_catalog.name: support.propose_plan_credit_record
tool_catalog.title: support.propose_plan_credit_record
tool_catalog.description:
Propose creating one bounded plan-credit record with source-enforced deduplication.
Returns a proposal id for one new account_credits row; source database unchanged until human approval and guarded apply.
Evidence handles are audit/replay handles; the model does not need to call them during this turn.

reason.description: Business reason tied to support evidence.

protected_read_query.sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT t0."region" AS "region", date_trunc('week', t0."churned_at") AS "churn_week", COUNT(*) AS "churned_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "__cohort_size", 'period_1' AS "__period" FROM "public"."subscriptions" t0 WHERE t0."tenant_id" = $1 AND t0."owner_id" = $2 AND t0."status" = $3 AND t0."churned_at" >= $4 AND t0."churned_at" < $5 GROUP BY t0."region", date_trunc('week', t0."churned_at") ORDER BY "churned_accounts" DESC LIMIT 21)) AS protected_periods
